rationale: The workflow already caches dependencies through actions/setup-node@v6 with cache: yarn, so the dependency-cache optimization (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE, supported by experiment batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9 and batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) is already satisfied; that pattern's own contraindication, an equivalent cache already exists, bars adding a redundant actions/cache step. Cancel-superseded-runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) is contraindicated because this is a deployment job that pushes to an external repository, and cancelling an in-flight deploy is unsafe. No matrix exists for fail-fast, and change-path filtering or workflow skipping could reduce required deploy coverage on push to main. A custom timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) was considered, but there is no verified representative duration baseline for this deployment job and the available history is labelled not a measured baseline, so a too-low limit risks false timeouts mid-deploy. No change preserves build and deploy coverage and adds no privileges, secrets, or network access.
